meta.themes: Frontier Platforms Expand Model Choice, AI Capital Spending Faces Market Tests, Compute Moves to New Architectures, Agent Tooling Adds Controls and Evaluation

news.title: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in ChatGPT Work and Codex
news.summary: Astra targets complex research and software work, while Sol combines reasoning with speed and efficiency; both models entered preview in Work and Codex desktop.

news.title: Microsoft expanded Foundry model choice and offered licensed MAI weights
news.summary: Microsoft brought GPT-6.2 and Meta's latest models to Foundry and announced MAI Licensed Weights for trusted customers through its Frontier organization.

news.title: Gemini 4 Neon became generally available in GitHub Copilot
news.summary: Google's agentic coding model reached Copilot surfaces with faster startup, lower per-task token cost, and fewer unrequested changes than Gemini 4 Carbon.

news.title: Anthropic closed its IPO and a $26 billion private placement
news.summary: Anthropic's offering raised about $93.5 billion gross, while a concurrent placement with seven chip and cloud companies lifted total gross proceeds to $119.5 billion.

news.title: Nvidia reported $107.6 billion in quarterly data center revenue
news.summary: Nvidia's fiscal third-quarter revenue reached $115.8 billion, up 103% year over year, as data center revenue rose 110% and Vera Rubin NVL72 began shipping.

news.title: Oracle said its OpenAI infrastructure contract is fully funded
news.summary: Oracle said its final capital raise secured the financing needed for the OpenAI contract, with its Abilene campus nearly complete and Shackelford fully permitted.

news.title: Nvidia expanded Vera into a rack-scale CPU platform for scientific computing
news.summary: The liquid-cooled platform links 192 Vera CPUs over Quantum-X800 InfiniBand and is planned from Dell, HPE, Lenovo, and Supermicro beginning in early 2027.

news.title: Google selected Blue Origin for Project Suncatcher's first heavy-lift launch
news.summary: A New Glenn launch targeted for early 2029 will deploy satellites with roughly one data center rack of compute each into sun-synchronous orbit.

news.title: Senate Democrats debated a select committee to accelerate AI regulation
news.summary: The proposal would consolidate work on safeguards as lawmakers consider data center rules, third-party evaluations, safety standards, monitoring, and research.

news.title: GitHub Copilot code review added adaptive effort and secret detection
news.summary: Copilot can now vary review depth by pull-request risk, use related public repositories for context, and flag both known-format and AI-detected secrets.

news.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore adopted Strands defaults and lifecycle hooks
news.summary: The managed harness added planning, web retrieval, filesystem and delegation tools plus deterministic checkpoints that can allow, deny, or record agent actions.

news.title: GitHub Copilot Evals entered public preview
news.summary: The local evaluation tool lets builders create repeatable tests for skills, agents, and MCP tools, inspect failures, and compare behavior before and after changes.
